metaTitle: Mercedes-Benz Engine Replacement & Fitting | Mercedes Garage
metaDescription: Professional Mercedes-Benz engine replacement service. Complete removal, fitting, and programming with Xentry diagnostics. Nationwide recovery available.
lede: Professional engine replacement service for all Mercedes-Benz models. Complete removal, fitting, and programming with manufacturer-grade tools.

blocks.html: Our engine replacement service covers the complete removal of your vehicle's existing engine and the fitting of a professionally prepared replacement unit. We handle every step in-house at our Billericay workshop:

items: Full vehicle inspection and system check prior to work
Safe removal of the old engine using specialised lifting equipment
Thorough cleaning and preparation of the engine bay
Transfer of all ancillary components (alternator, pumps, sensors, wiring)
Precise installation of the replacement engine with manufacturer-specified torque settings
Reconnection of cooling, fuel, exhaust, and electrical systems
Fluid filling and system bleeding (oil, coolant, transmission fluid where required)
ECU programming and adaptation using **Xentry** diagnostic system – including 48V mild-hybrid and V12 M275 engines
Comprehensive road testing and final quality control

blocks.html: We use genuine Mercedes-Benz service data and tooling to ensure full compatibility and performance. For modern 48V systems, we follow strict high-voltage safety protocols. For V12 engines, we apply specialised timing and torque procedures.

Our engine replacement costs are quoted per vehicle based on the specific engine type and condition. As a guide, our **engine rebuild** starting prices are listed below – replacement pricing includes the cost of the replacement unit and is provided as a fixed quote after inspection.

paras: [Pricing disclaimer](/pricing-legal-disclaimer) – actual replacement costs vary; contact us for a personalised quote.

steps.body: We inspect your vehicle to confirm the engine specification and document all connections.
Drain fluids, disconnect ancillaries, and carefully remove the old engine using a hoist.
Transfer required components, install new seals and gaskets, and verify compatibility.
Lower the replacement engine into place, secure mounts, and reconnect all systems.
Fill with correct fluids and perform ECU adaptation using Xentry diagnostic tools.
Conduct thorough leak checks, road testing, and final quality control before collection.

items.q: What does a Mercedes-Benz engine replacement involve?
items.a: The process includes vehicle inspection, removal of the old engine, preparation of the replacement unit, installation, connection of all ancillaries, fluid fills, ECU programming with Xentry, and final road testing.

items.q: How long does an engine replacement take?
items.a: Most Mercedes engine replacements are completed within 2 working days, depending on the model and complexity. We prioritise efficient turnaround while ensuring thorough quality checks.

items.q: What warranty do you offer on an engine replacement?
items.a: All our engine replacement work comes with a 12-month, unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour.

items.q: Do you handle 48V mild-hybrid and V12 engines?
items.a: Yes. We are fully equipped to replace engines from all Mercedes model lines, including 48V MHEV systems and the complex V12 M275, using manufacturer-level diagnostic tools and safety protocols.

items.q: Do I need to bring the car to you, or do you offer collection?
items.a: We offer nationwide recovery from £70, with most vehicles collected within a few hours of booking. We also accept vehicles delivered to our Billericay workshop.
